builds.version: PortMaster package (rolling; retail game version user-supplied)
builds.notes: PortMaster port.json declares aarch64, with launch script/native engine inspected. Native ARM64 Mono 6.12 plus game-specific MonoGame patches and loader. Requires the purchased compatibility version, not the default Stardew Valley build. Requires PortMaster and applicable native runtime or controller/graphics libraries. NOT tested on Steam Frame; do not assume this package works directly on SteamOS.
